title: draft_response output
description: Strict output schema for the draft_response OpenClaw skill. approval_required is hard-locked to true in Phase 1. draft_body must be a clean customer-facing reply with no internal metadata (no DRAFT marker, lane names, or SOP ids — those live in the Monday card / audit fields only).

draft_body.description: Clean customer-facing reply only. Must NOT contain internal metadata: no [DRAFT ...] footer, no 'pending human approval' marker, no lane names, no SOP/REF/ARCH ids. That metadata lives in the Monday card/audit fields only.
